blind.B1: No. GSE281241 is unstimulated WT vs ChR2::tdTomato C2C12 myotubes (6 vs 6), a genotype/cell-line comparison used to show optogenetic muscle is a surrogate for wild type (S2.1, Fig S2b). No exercise or contraction arm in the metadata (packet A: no exercise words). The paper cites only GSE257540 (S4.8.p2, DA.p1).
blind.B2: None for exercise; the only related comparison is WT vs optogenetic muscle gene expression (Fig S2b), n=6 per genotype per GEO.
blind.B3: Suffix of key (1-6) links WT and ChR2 samples once each, but the GEO protocol says 6 separate wells per genotype; expression check not supported (r=-0.05, p=0.76). Not a repeated measure.
blind.B5: Paper: DEGs from DESeq2 with Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p (FIG7 legend; S4.10.p1: raw and BH-adjusted p reported, normal prior and ashr); no numeric cutoff or fold-change rule stated. Counts: 194 DEGs across the three biochemical comparisons (S2.4.p3, union); mechanical: 2 significant hits, both up (S2.4.p4). FIG7j heatmap uses nominal p for the top 50 genes. Not applicable to this series (not analyzed in the paper).

checks.evidence: Refused: genotype comparison with no exercise arm (S2.1, Fig S2b surrogate check; treatment constant in metadata)
No analysis run; ChR2 6 / WT 6 correct from characteristics_ch1.3.genotype
Key 'suffix of key' links 12/12 but pairing_check is not_supported (same-key r -0.05, permutation p 0.76) and the protocol describes independent wells; not used, correct
Non-integer Salmon estimated counts identified (integer_fraction 0.918) and rounding planned; not executed
HANDBACK claims no paper analysis and makes no comparison; consistent
Reason (genotype only, no exercise arm) is true and the check was wide: all columns, series design and paper; it does not rest on an absent-data claim such as animal ID

human_items: Whether in-vitro surrogate-validation series count as exercise studies is the open in-vitro policy question; here the factor is genotype, not stimulation, so the refusal is consistent.
summary: GSE281241 为未刺激的 WT 与 ChR2 C2C12 肌管的基因型比较，没有运动或收缩处理组，论文也未分析该系列，拒绝理由成立且检验范围充分。配对键经表达检验不被支持，且方案描述为独立孔。整体通过。
